ftb.guhs_guhrio.title: &cSuper Guhrio
ftb.guhs_guhrio.sub: Thank you! But the princess is in another part of the castle, nyeg
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.intro_guhs_guhrio.desc:
This chapter comes after &6WAHOOG, It's Burning Again!&r in &6The Guhbarbecuether&r.

In a frying sauce sea of the Guhbarbecuether stands &cBig Nether Mika's Castle&r (Super Compass: Barbecue). On the forecourt &dToad-guh&r is waiting: Princess Peachguh has been taken away... for a piece of cake.

Inside you play everything &cfrom the side&r: A and D walk, space jumps. Falling costs nothing: you simply start again at your last flag. Nothing is locked: every quest ticks itself off as soon as you've done it, even if you did it before. The headings show what logically comes next. Tick this off and get chonking!
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_kasteel.title: A Castle in the Sauce
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_kasteel.desc: Right in the middle of the Guhbarbecuether's frying sauce sea stands &6Big Nether Mika's Castle&r. The Super Compass (Barbecue > Big Nether Mika's Castle) shows the way; there's a little jetty in front of the gate.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_binnen.title: Seen from the Side
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_binnen.desc: In the level hall, walk through the gate of &6level 1-1&r. Inside a level you look from the side: &dA&r and &dD&r walk, &dspace&r jumps (hold it = higher), &dS&r dives into a pipe, &dW&r goes through a door, sprinting is running. Nothing ever breaks and nobody hurts you: if you fall or get shoved, you're simply back at your last flag. &dQ&r twice = out.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_levels.title: Six Flagpoles
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_levels.desc: Reach the flagpole of all six levels: the courtyard (1-1, 1-2), the cellars (2-1, 2-2) and the keep (3-1, 3-2). Each gate opens once the level before it is cleared.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_vadsmunten.desc: Every level hides three &6big chonk coins&r. They stay yours, even when you play the level again; the Guhdex (Tales > Super Guhrio) keeps track of which ones you have, level by level.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_loop.title: All in One Dash
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_loop.desc: Start at level 1-1 and clear all six levels back to back, in order. Your time goes on the high score board (Guhdex > High Scores), next to the server record. Time you lose by stepping out of a level still counts, nyeg.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w1_1_1.title: Level 1-1: The Courtyard
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w1_1_1.desc: The first gate on the left in the level hall. A painted lawn inside the castle walls: here you learn to walk, jump, bonk &6question blocks&r and land on top of &dGuhmbas&r. At the end of the lawn you dive into the big green pipe (&dS&r) and walk across the clouds and the treetops to the flagpole. Nyeg!
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w1_1_2.title: Level 1-2: The Hedge Garden
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w1_1_2.desc: The first gate on the right. Hedges to climb, cheese ponds to jump over and a &dShell Mika&r with a row of Guhmbas in front of him: jump on him and kick his shell away. Through the tower door (&dW&r) you get on top of the garden wall; that's where the flagpole stands.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w1_prinses.titl: In Another Part of the Castle
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w1_prinses.desc: Behind the flagpole of level 1-2, &dToad-guh&r is already waving. He has good news and bad news. &oThank you! But the princess is in another part of the castle, nyeg.&r The gate to the cellars (world 2) is open now.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w1_vads_1_1.tit: Three Times Chonk in the Courtyard
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w1_vads_1_1.des: The three &6big chonk coins&r of level 1-1. One lies on top of the bricks (climb the hedge behind them and jump back), one lies on a little cloud (why is there a lone coin floating there?), and one lies somewhere only a mole ever goes. Then reach the flagpole.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w1_vads_1_2.tit: Three Times Chonk in the Hedge Garden
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w1_vads_1_2.des: The three &6big chonk coins&r of level 1-2. One sits in a little box of bricks: you can only get in when you're big (the &dSuper Nibble&r is in the block just before it). One hangs high above the gap behind the little wall tower: jump far. And one is on the gardener's shelf. Then reach the flagpole.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w1_geheim_1_1.d: Not every pipe in the courtyard is just a pipe. Above one of them floats a little coin. Try diving in (&dS&r), nyeg.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w1_geheim_1_2.d: On top of the hedge arch of level 1-2 there's a door. But how do you get up there? Next to the low little hedge in front of it, two coins float one above the other... try jumping underneath them. Some blocks you only see once you bonk your head against them.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w2_buizenkelder: The gate of &6level 2-1&r opens as soon as you've cleared the courtyard (1-1 and 1-2). Down here it's dark and packed with &agreen pipes&r: stand on one and press &dS&r to dive in. Watch out for the &dChomp Flowers&r: as long as one of those flowers is poking out of her pipe, you get a big wet smooch and you're back at your flag. Platforms glide back and forth over the cheese sauce; waiting is allowed, nyeg.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w2_vads.title: Cellar Chonk
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w2_vads.desc: Find all six &6big chonk coins&r of the cellars. Two tips. In level 2-1 one hangs in a red cage: the &bexclamation switch&r that opens the cage is at the end of a little tunnel you don't fit into. A &dShell Mika&r's shell does: jump on him and give his shell a nudge. And in level 2-2 one lies in a spot you can only reach through a pipe, nyeg.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w2_ei.title: A Speckled Egg
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w2_ei.desc: In &6level 2-2&r a fence with an &degg lock&r is in the way. It only opens for whoever is carrying &aGuhshi's Egg&r. Look for the door under the painted egg (press &dW&r when you're standing in it): in the little egg room it lies on a bed of hay.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w2_uitgebroed.d: Carry the egg through the egg lock to the &6hatching nest&r, a warm little stove with straw on top. That's where &aGuhshi&r hatches from his egg. He thinks you're his mama. Jump onto the nest and he'll carry you: hold &dspace&r to flutter and click to stick out his tongue. Whoever bumps into you gets Guhshi instead of you; he then goes back to wait on his nest.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w2_nest.title: Level 2-2: Guhshi's Nest
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w2_nest.desc: Ride Guhshi to the flagpole of &6level 2-2&r. You cross the big gap in the floor by fluttering (or on foot, on the slow platform). After that the gate of the keep opens: level 3-1.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w2_warp.title: Shortcut
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w2_warp.desc: Not every pipe comes out where you think. Somewhere in level 2-2 a Chomp Flower lives in a pipe that leads to the &5warp room&r: three golden pipes with a number above them. Dive in and you're in that level right away, and its gate in the hall stays open for you from then on. The level you left from doesn't count as cleared then, nyeg.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w3_3_1.title: Level 3-1: The Grill Corridor
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w3_3_1.desc: The gate of &6level 3-1&r opens once the cellars are cleared. Here &dGuhshi&r waits for whoever found his egg: walk into him and you're in the saddle. Hold space = flutter. Jump across the sauce from hub to hub of the spinning &6grill skewers&r and lure the &6Flomp Mikas&r down before you run underneath them. At the &dhitching post&r Guhshi waits for a bit: the part with the &6Fire Pepper&r you do on foot (a nibble through the gap flips the switch).
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w3_3_2.title: Level 3-2: The Sauce Cellar
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w3_3_2.desc: Guhshi's level. Two gaps are so wide that only his flutter jump makes it across (on foot, the &dtimer switch&r lays a bridge over them for eight seconds). In between: falling blocks under fast skewers, a platform under two Flomp Mikas, and behind a door the &6Pepper Room&r.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w3_vadsmunten.t: Six Times Chonk in the Keep
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w3_vadsmunten.d: The six &6big chonk coins&r of world 3. Tip: one hangs above the middle grill skewer, one lies under a Flomp Mika, one in a treasure room you can only reach through a pipe with a Chomp Flower, one high above the first big gap, one low between two falling blocks (a tiny hop!) and one in the cage of the Pepper Room.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w3_hendel.title: Round 1: The Lever
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w3_hendel.desc: Behind the big gate, &6Big Nether Mika&r stands on his grate bridge. He throws slow glowing embers (jump over them) and when he lands, the thud shoves you away (jump at the right moment). Run &dunderneath him&r while he hangs in the air and pull the &6lever&r: half the bridge flomps into the sauce. The green pipe takes you back.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w3_schild.title: Round 2 and 3: Shell, Return to Sender
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w3_schild.desc: On the short bridge he tucks into his shell and rolls back and forth: &djump over it&r. After three bonks against the wall the &6?-block&r is full again: grab the &6Fire Pepper&r and throw a nibble at the shell while it's rolling toward you. Then it bounces right back. Three on target and he can't brake anymore.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w3_duel.title: Big Nether Mika
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w3_duel.desc: Win the duel. He splashes into the sauce, climbs back out on the other side (wet, sticky, offended, otherwise perfectly fine) and sits down to sulk. Nobody hurts anybody here, nyeg.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w3_taart.title: A Piece of Cake
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_w3_taart.desc: Watch how it ends: &dPrincess Peachguh&r, the cake, and why Big Nether Mika had taken her along in the first place. The Guhdex (Tales > Super Guhrio) plays the scene again. After that you're standing in the tower room.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_beloning_padguh: On the left of the castle forecourt stands a giant mushroom: &6Toad-guh&r's stall. He tells you what's going on: Big Nether Mika has taken Princess Peachguh away. For a piece of cake.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_beloning_winkel: The &6coins&r from the levels go into your pouch (a coin counts the first time you grab it). At Toad-guh's you spend them on &doutfits&r and &dbuilding blocks&r. At every flagpole you also get a little tip: one coin for every five on your panel.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_beloning_rode_p: The &cred cap with mustache&r costs 30 coins. Hold it (hold right-click) to unlock it and put it on your guh in the wardrobe. The mustache comes free.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_beloning_groene: Luiguh's &agreen cap&r costs 30 coins. No mustache, but just as brave. Mostly.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_beloning_schild: The &aShell Mika Shell&r costs 40 coins. It won't make your guh slide any faster, but it sure looks tough.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_beloning_vraagb: You can put the &6Nibble Question Block&r down at home. Bonk it with your head: every day one cheese nibble pops out, one for each player. There's one on the forecourt too: go on, try it!
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_beloning_pijp.d: The &aGreen Travel Pipe&r really works. Put two down (at most 50 blocks apart), stand on a pipe and &dsneak&r: you slide in and come out of the other one. With dye you make a second pair in another color. There's a pair ready on the forecourt.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_beloning_mast.d: Stack &aCastle Flagpoles&r on top of each other: a base appears at the bottom by itself, and at the top the golden ball with the little pink flag. Click it for a little party.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_beloning_bord.d: On the right of the forecourt stands the &6high score board&r: the server's fastest times, per level and for the whole castle in one go. Click the golden block and you'll see your own times next to them.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_beloning_perzik: Win the duel with Big Nether Mika and talk to &dPrincess Peachguh&r in the tower room. She gives you her little crown and a cake. Kidnapped? Nah: the cake was just really yummy.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_beloning_guhshi: Next to the princess, &aGuhshi&r is waiting. Click him and say yes: you get a Guhshi of your own, saddle and all. One per player; the one in the tower room stays there for the next hero.
A Guhshi of your own gets his page in the &dGuhdex&r. On his back you jump with &dspace&r; hold space in the air and he &dflutters&r across gaps as wide as seven blocks.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_beloning_tong.d: Put a cheese nibble on the ground near your Guhshi. Zip: his long tongue snaps it up from as far as five blocks away. In his guh menu you can switch the tongue off if he needs to keep his paws off your stuff.
ftb.guhs_guhrio.q.guhrio_beloning_gouden: Got all &6eighteen big chonk coins&r? Then go see Toad-guh: he has the &6Golden Chonk Cap&r for you. The Guhdex (Tales > Toad-guh's Stall and the Rewards) shows per level which chonk coins you're still missing.
